subject: ela
intro: Read and pick the word's meaning.

items.prompt:
Read.

The owl is nocturnal. It is awake at night.

'Nocturnal' means:
A) Awake at night
B) Awake in the day
C) Always asleep

steps: Clue: awake at night. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The river is swift. It moves very fast.

'Swift' means:
A) Slow
B) Fast
C) Deep

Read.

The night was frigid. It was freezing cold.

'Frigid' means:
A) Warm
B) Very cold
C) Wet

Read.

The desert is arid. Almost no rain falls.

'Arid' means:
A) Very wet
B) Very dry
C) Very cold

steps: Almost no rain. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The box was fragile and broke easily.

'Fragile' means:
A) Strong
B) Easily broken
C) Heavy

Read.

The lake was shallow; it came to our knees.

'Shallow' means:
A) Very deep
B) Not deep
C) Frozen

steps: Only to the knees. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The camel is hardy; it survives long trips with little water.

'Hardy' means:
A) Weak
B) Tough and strong
C) Thirsty

steps: Survives hard trips. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The seed was dormant and would grow in spring.

'Dormant' means:
A) Growing fast
B) Resting, not active
C) Dead

steps: Not growing yet. Key is B.
